exposure: reported vector exposure (living in an infested house)
outcome: congenital T. cruzi transmission to infants
cohort: The study included 596 pregnant women presenting for delivery in a large urban hospital in Bolivia, 128 of whom had confirmed T. cruzi infection, and their infants.
finding: Maternal parasite load was significantly higher among women who transmitted T. cruzi to their infants, and infected women without reported vector exposure had significantly higher parasite loads than those with a history of living in an infested house.
